applied.problem: "Change the input inside the bracket and it slides left or right" overreaches: after lesson 6, multiplying the input inside, f(2x), squeezes the graph instead; only adding or taking a number inside slides it.

"Outside the bracket moves it up or down" and "Inside moves it sideways" stop holding after lesson 6, where 2f(x) stretches and f(2x) squeezes; the rule is about a number added or taken away, so it is narrowed to say so.
The stated limit is false: a timer set early slides its chart left, so timers can show both directions; a real break is that a daily chart wraps round at midnight while a graph does not.
